2115784562026700923.en_summary: @TheTranscript_ lists big tech capex: $MSFT about $170B for FY 26/27, expected to accelerate in the second half; $GOOGL holding at $195B to $205B for 2026 and expected to increase significantly in 2027; $META $135B to $145B for 2026, expecting to keep investing aggressively. A subscription link is included.
2115784562026700923.zh_summary: @TheTranscript_ 列出大型科技公司資本開支：$MSFT 2026/27 財年約 1,700 億美元，預期下半年加速；$GOOGL 2026 年維持 1,950 億至 2,050 億美元，預期 2027 年大幅增加；$META 2026 年為 1,350 億至 1,450 億美元，預期繼續積極投資。附上訂閱連結。

2115786092125499781.en_summary: @StockSavvyShay thinks the market is underestimating $NOW, because even if $GOOGL Gemini or ChatGPT becomes the interface employees use, that does not replace the systems doing the actual work. He finds Action Fabric interesting because outside AI agents can tap its enterprise data and workflows, and the company could earn more revenue as those agents complete more tasks. An image is attached.
2115786092125499781.zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay 認為市場低估了 $NOW，因為即使 $GOOGL 的 Gemini 或 ChatGPT 成為員工使用的介面，也不代表會取代實際執行工作的系統。他認為 Action Fabric 很有意思，因為外部 AI 代理可以接入其企業數據和工作流程，而隨著這些代理完成更多任務，公司可能賺取更多收入。附上圖片。

2115786641566802249.en_summary: @TheTranscript_ says $GOOGL Alphabet's revenue mix is shifting, with Google Cloud playing an increasingly important role, which explains why Google Cloud CEO Thomas Kurian joined the earnings call. He quotes his earlier post noting Kurian's debut on the call. An image is attached.
2115786641566802249.zh_summary: @TheTranscript_ 表示 $GOOGL Alphabet 的收入結構正在轉變，Google Cloud 的角色日益重要，這也解釋了為何 Google Cloud 執行長 Thomas Kurian 出席了財報電話會議。他引用自己早前提到 Kurian 首次出席會議的貼文。附上圖片。
